card.name: Words introducing quantities and time spans
card.fires_on: Small words and digits that lead into a number or a length of time, such as "over" before "the past decade", "about" before a count, or a digit inside a clock time or age. Found in general news and web prose.

modes.label: Over/for before a time span
modes.description: The word "over" or "for" that starts a stretch of years or decades.

modes.label: Approximation or comparison word
modes.description: "about" or "than" placed right before a number or amount.
modes.example: followed by a printed questionnaire that was returned by<< about>> 1,300 people.

modes.label: Digit inside a time or age
modes.description: A digit within a clock time, hour range or decade of age.

card.writes: It favors quote-mark openers and suppresses JSON-style quote tokens and speaking words, with no obvious link to the quantity pattern.
card.plain: It lights up on little words and digits that lead into a number, a time of day or a span of years.
